a: Observing time on the e-MERLIN radio interferometer (L, C and K bands; 12-150 mas resolution) for Cycle 23, submitted through the Polaris proposal tool from 1 Oct 2026. Lovell telescope availability is limited this cycle. Joint EVN+e-MERLIN observations go through the EVN call. No funding.
dt: Deadline 13:59:59 UT on 22 Oct 2026. Observations 1 Feb to 31 Jul 2027.
e: The UK's national radio interferometer facility. It requests proposals from the international astronomical community; the e-MERLIN TAC reviews them under STFC rules, on scientific merit and technical feasibility alone. Proposals must follow dual-anonymous guidelines, and projects that include researchers affiliated with Russian institutes are not accepted.
f: e-MERLIN / Jodrell Bank Observatory (University of Manchester; STFC)
unv: Grad-student PI status is not stated in the call.
